name: Reiver Re-enactor Nixon

intro.text: I'm a Nixon. Fifteen generations of fine, upstanding raiders. I do the weekend shows now. We steal cattle, in a safe and fully insured way.

win: Fair play. Take a bite of this: it's a mutton roll and it's not the raiders' own.
after: The trick to reiving was to ride out in the dark and be back by morning, with everyone else's cattle. The trick to re-enacting is to be back in time for tea.
